name: How long does kitchen cabinet installation usually take?

step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation & Design (1-3 weeks)
step.text: This phase is all about understanding your vision, measuring your space, and selecting the perfect cabinets. We'll discuss styles, materials, and layouts to ensure everything is just right. This is usually the longest planning phase, and your involvement here is key to getting the design you truly want.

step.name: Step 2: Cabinet Ordering & Delivery (4-8 weeks)
step.text: Once the design is finalized, your chosen cabinets are ordered. Custom or semi-custom cabinets typically take longer to manufacture and deliver than off-the-shelf options. We manage this process to keep you updated on lead times.

step.name: Step 3: Demolition & Preparation (1-3 days)
step.text: Before new cabinets go in, the old ones need to come out. This step includes carefully removing existing cabinets, and sometimes minor wall repairs or adjustments to prepare the space for the new installation. We ensure the area is clean and ready.

step.name: Step 4: New Cabinet Installation (3-7 days)
step.text: This is where your new kitchen really starts to take shape! Our skilled team precisely installs the base cabinets, then the upper cabinets, ensuring everything is level, plumb, and securely fastened. This includes any island cabinetry or custom features. We work meticulously to ensure a perfect fit and finish.

step.name: Step 5: Finishing Touches & Adjustments (1-2 days)
step.text: After the main installation, we’ll make any final adjustments to doors and drawers, install hardware, and ensure everything is functioning smoothly. This phase might also include installing crown molding or other decorative elements. This is typically done before countertop installation. So, from concept to completion, you're usually looking at an overall timeline of about 6 to 12 weeks, with the actual physical installation being much quicker. This schedule allows for quality craftsmanship and smooth coordination. Ready to start? Get a free, no-obligation estimate from us!
